When more than one fits

Start with an experience, not a verdict about yourself.

You may recognize a combination of worry, low mood, strain in a relationship, or a difficult transition. You do not have to decide which label explains everything before asking for support. These pages are educational routes through the library, not a diagnostic questionnaire.

One starting question is what has become harder in an ordinary day. Another is what has changed recently. Use what you read to find words for your experience, then let an appropriate clinical conversation consider the full picture.

Learning and care are different steps

A guide can give you language. A clinician can learn your situation.

The starting-care page explains introductory and clinical appointment options. A request for a time is not a confirmed booking.
